versions.changelog:
- Expanded the workflow to include upgrade requests, algorithm family mapping, and platform maturity checks.
- Added steps for request routing, family-aware teaching patterns, and upgrade guidance using new internal reference files.
- Final quality checks now reference an external checklist to ensure structural and educational standards.
- Updated design and output rules to reflect expanded references and new guidelines for extensibility and reusable platforms.
- Removed the internal output-quality-checklist.md file (now referenced externally).

- Initial release with full workflow and instructional guidance for building interactive algorithm learning pages.
- Added core planning and generation process, including workflow steps for request classification, audience adaptation, teaching structure, formula explanation, and interaction controls.
- Included detailed output and design requirements for both planning requests and complete runnable HTML educational pages.
- Added "references/output-quality-checklist.md" and "references/request-routing-rules.md" for improved quality control and request handling.

- Initial release of algorithm-learning-platform-builder skill.
- Generates interactive, browser-runnable algorithm teaching pages and educational platforms.
- Supports planning, structuring, and creating dynamic content with formulas, step-by-step calculations, charts, and parameter controls.
- Adapts teaching structure and detail level to the audience (beginner or advanced).
- Provides comparison pages, reusable platforms, and runnable HTML demos when requested.
- Emphasizes clarity, educational value, and structured outputs for learning algorithms.
